en: Colorized vintage street view showing Bahnhofstrasse in a European town. Multi‑storey stone townhouses line the left side, while on the right is a large corner building with a sign reading "Neustädter Bank". People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk along the wide, mostly empty street that leads towards a church tower in the distance. The sky is softly tinted and the scene has the typical printed look of an old postcard. At the top, red text labels the location as "Neustadt i. Sa., Bahnhofstrasse".
